layout.page_table: ByteAddressBuffer Load2(8*PageTableIndex): word0 = SampleAtlasBiasX[0:12] | SampleAtlasBiasY[12:24] | SampleCardResLevelX[24:28] | SampleCardResLevelY[28:32]; word1 = SamplePageIndex
layout.valid_page_rule: a page is current/valid here only when referenced by a page span of a valid card; unreferenced payload rows are retained buffer contents and are reported separately

identity_evidence.imported_alias_reason: Lumen.PageTable is a persistent pooled ByteAddressBuffer imported into the graph; the v0 payload is used only after layout/bounds/ownership checks
CardPageHighResLastUsedBuffer is a persistent pooled buffer; only its 1024 uint frame counters are read and page indices are bounds-checked

capacity.buffer_capacity_note: 1024 entries is the allocated GPU capacity; only the mapped+referenced subset is current page residency
